enunciado: Define enum Form with data-carrying variants: Circle(radius), Rect(width, height) and Point. Write formArea(f) with match and compute the area of several forms. Compare this solution with the polymorphic version from the abstract class exercise.
objetivos: Model a closed set of variants carrying data
pistas: Each match case names the variant's fields.
The compiler checks that you cover every variant.
Sum types: closed variants, open operations. Inheritance: the opposite.
